name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon toolhead
source: EdgeSlicer estimate, no CAD or measurement available. Nozzle: a generic brass nozzle outline (about 1 mm tip land, cone of roughly 40 degrees half-angle) rounded to whole tenths. Sock, housing and carriage: round-number boxes chosen to be conservative for a CoreXY head of this size. Gantry rod height 36 mm is Elegoo's extruder_clearance_height_to_rod from the Centauri Carbon machine profile; its Y span is estimated. Heater block and sock bottom lowered from 4 mm to 2.5 mm above the tip (2026-11-16): a guess, not measured, set to the curved-tops spike's 2.0 mm allowed rise plus the 0.5 mm margin, which the owner's Dome40 print on this printer cleared (1.8 mm rise). Measure before relying on any of it.

curved_tops.verified_note: Owner's print of CurvedTops_Dome40_CC1 (40 mm puck, 1.8 mm spherical cap, edge slope 10.3 deg, 3 curved layers, 0.20mm Standard @Elegoo CC 0.4 nozzle, Elegoo PLA) printed well, per the hand-test card (tests/design_curved_tops.md). The head itself was never measured.
